WITH per_cust AS (
  SELECT c.Segment AS seg, SUM(ym.Consumption) AS total
  FROM customers c
  JOIN yearmonth ym ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
  WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK' AND ym.Date LIKE '2013%'
  GROUP BY c.CustomerID
),
seg AS (
  SELECT seg, AVG(total) AS av FROM per_cust GROUP BY seg
)
SELECT
  (SELECT av FROM seg WHERE seg = 'SME') - (SELECT av FROM seg WHERE seg = 'LAM') AS "SME-LAM",
  (SELECT av FROM seg WHERE seg = 'LAM') - (SELECT av FROM seg WHERE seg = 'KAM') AS "LAM-KAM",
  (SELECT av FROM seg WHERE seg = 'KAM') - (SELECT av FROM seg WHERE seg = 'SME') AS "KAM-SME"

WITH yearly AS (

SELECT t2012.seg,
       (t2013.total - t2012.total) / t2012.total * 100 AS pct_change
FROM yearly t2012
JOIN yearly t2013 ON t2012.seg = t2013.seg AND t2013.yr='2013'
WHERE t2012.yr='2012'

WITH y AS (

  FROM yearmonth ym

  GROUP BY ym.CustomerID
),
s AS (
  SELECT c.Segment AS Segment, AVG(y.total) AS avg_total
  FROM y
  JOIN customers c ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
  GROUP BY c.Segment
)
SELECT
 (SELECT avg_total FROM s WHERE Segment='SME') - (SELECT avg_total FROM s WHERE Segment='LAM') AS SME_LAM,
 (SELECT avg_total FROM s WHERE Segment='LAM') - (SELECT avg_total FROM s WHERE Segment='KAM') AS LAM_KAM,
 (SELECT avg_total FROM s WHERE Segment='KAM') - (SELECT avg_total FROM s WHERE Segment='SME') AS KAM_SME;

SELECT DISTINCT TRIM(tag) AS Tag
FROM (
  WITH RECURSIVE split(postid, rest, tag) AS (
    SELECT p.Id,
           REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(p.Tags,'><','|'),'<',''),'>',''),
           NULL
    FROM posts p
    WHERE p.OwnerUserId = (SELECT Id FROM users WHERE DisplayName = 'Mark Meckes')
      AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM comments c WHERE c.PostId = p.Id)
      AND p.Tags IS NOT NULL
    UNION ALL
    SELECT postid,
           CASE WHEN INSTR(rest,'|')>0 THEN SUBSTR(rest, INSTR(rest,'|')+1) ELSE '' END,
           CASE WHEN INSTR(rest,'|')>0 THEN SUBSTR(rest,1,INSTR(rest,'|')-1) ELSE rest END
    FROM split WHERE rest <> ''
  )
  SELECT tag FROM split WHERE tag IS NOT NULL AND tag <> ''
)
WHERE TRIM(tag) <> '';

FROM Patient p

WITH p AS (SELECT ID, MIN(PLT) AS mn, MAX(PLT) AS mx FROM Laboratory WHERE PLT IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ID)
SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM p WHERE mn < 150) AS lower_than_normal,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM p WHERE mx > 400) AS higher_than_normal,
  CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM p WHERE mn < 150) > (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM p WHERE mx > 400)
       THEN 'More patients with lower than normal platelet level'
       WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM p WHERE mn < 150) < (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM p WHERE mx > 400)
       THEN 'More patients with higher than normal platelet level'
       ELSE 'Equal' END AS comparison
